answer: The karst register is checked at draw time, vertex lists the eligible set, and onyx seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 67 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 67 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. Bonded capital sits idle for 18 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
